passages.title: 醫院裡的小丑阿姨
passages.text: Every Saturday, my aunt goes to the children's {1} in Taipei. She isn't a doctor or a nurse. She is a clown! She {2} wears a red nose, a funny hat, and big yellow shoes. Sick kids often feel scared and bored when they {3} for the doctor, so my aunt visits them and does magic tricks. Last month, I went with her for the first time. A little boy named Leo didn't want to talk to anyone. My aunt pulled a coin out of his ear, and he laughed for the first time in days. His mother almost cried. My aunt is {4} in that hospital. Every kid there knows her name, and some of them even draw pictures of her. Now I have a new {5}: I'm learning magic, too. Maybe one day I can make kids smile like she does.

blanks.why: children's hospital「兒童醫院」，後面又說她不是醫生或護士，可知是醫院。season（季節）、interest（興趣）、ticket（票）都不是可以「去」的地方。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 wears 前面，表示習慣。below、away、than 不能放在主詞和動詞之間修飾動詞。
wait for + 人「等待某人」：生病的小孩等醫生時會害怕又無聊。travel、follow、grow for the doctor 意思不通。
be famous in + 地方「在某處很有名」，下一句「那裡每個小孩都知道她的名字」就是證明。hard、least、own 放在這裡意思不通。
a new interest「新的興趣」，冒號後面說明是學魔術。season、hospital、weather 都不能用學魔術來說明。

passages.zh: 每個星期六，我阿姨都會去台北的兒童醫院。她不是醫生也不是護士，她是小丑！她通常戴著紅鼻子、滑稽的帽子，穿著黃色的大鞋子。生病的小孩在等醫生的時候常常覺得害怕又無聊，所以阿姨會去看他們、表演魔術。上個月，我第一次跟她一起去。有個叫 Leo 的小男孩不想跟任何人說話。阿姨從他耳朵裡變出一枚硬幣，他笑了，那是他好幾天來第一次笑。他媽媽差點哭出來。阿姨在那家醫院很有名，那裡每個小孩都知道她的名字，有些還會畫她的畫像。現在我有了一個新興趣：我也在學魔術。也許有一天，我也能像她一樣讓小孩露出笑容。

passages.title: 櫻花季的人潮
passages.text: Every spring, the cherry blossom {1} brings thousands of visitors to Wuling Farm in Taichung. The farm is {2} for its beautiful pink trees. Last March, my family decided to {3} there by car. We left home at five in the morning because Dad wanted to beat the crowds. But when we arrived, the parking lot was {4} full! Hundreds of people had the same idea. We had to park far away and {5} in a long line for the shuttle bus. It took almost an hour. Finally, we walked under the trees. Pink flowers were everywhere, and some of them fell on our heads like snow. Everyone was taking photos, and my little sister ate three ice creams. It was crowded, but it was beautiful. On the way home, Dad said, "Next year, let's come on a weekday."

blanks.why: cherry blossom season「櫻花季」，每年春天吸引大批遊客。hospital、interest、ticket 和 cherry blossom 連用意思不通。
be famous for + 特色「以…聞名」：農場以粉紅色的樹聞名。already、usually、together 後面不能接 for its trees 表示「以…出名」。
travel there by car「開車去那裡旅行」。notice、answer、understand there by car 意思不通。
already「已經」：我們到的時候停車場已經滿了。than、since、until 不能放在 was 和形容詞 full 中間。
wait in line「排隊等候」：我們排了很長的隊等接駁車。travel、grow、build in a long line 意思不通。

passages.zh: 每年春天，櫻花季都會吸引成千上萬的遊客到台中的武陵農場。這座農場以美麗的粉紅色櫻花樹聞名。去年三月，我們全家決定開車去那裡玩。我們早上五點就出門，因為爸爸想避開人潮。可是我們到的時候，停車場已經滿了！好幾百個人都跟我們想的一樣。我們只好把車停在很遠的地方，排很長的隊等接駁車，等了將近一個小時。終於，我們走到了櫻花樹下。到處都是粉紅色的花，有些花瓣像雪一樣落在我們頭上。大家都在拍照，我妹妹吃了三支冰淇淋。雖然人很多，但真的很美。回家路上，爸爸說：「明年我們平日來吧。」

passages.title: 跟著導航開進稻田
passages.text: My uncle loves to {1} around Taiwan in his old car. He {2} uses a paper map, but last summer he bought a new phone and decided to {3} the GPS instead. Everything was fine at first. Then the voice on the phone said, "Turn right." My uncle turned right and drove onto a narrow road between rice fields. The road got smaller and smaller, and finally the car got stuck in the mud. A farmer came over and laughed. "You're the third car this week!" he said. "The GPS has sent people down this road {4} last month." While the farmer went to get his tractor, my uncle had to {5} by the road for an hour. Mosquitoes bit his arms and legs. When he finally got home, he told us, "I'll still use the GPS, but I'll use my eyes, too."

blanks.why: love to travel around Taiwan「喜歡環島旅行」。answer、notice、prepare around Taiwan 意思不通。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 uses 前面，表示平常的習慣，和後面「但去年夏天改用導航」形成對比。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
follow the GPS「跟著導航走」。wait 要說 wait for；travel the GPS、hope the GPS 意思不通。
since + 過去時間點，搭配現在完成式 has sent「從上個月以來」。than、whether、below 不能接 last month 表示時間。
wait by the road「在路邊等」：農夫去開曳引機時，叔叔只能等。follow、build、order by the road 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我叔叔很喜歡開著他的老車環島旅行。他通常用紙本地圖，但去年夏天他買了新手機，決定改跟著導航走。一開始都很順利。後來手機裡的聲音說：「請右轉。」叔叔右轉，開上了一條稻田中間的小路。路越來越窄，最後車子陷進泥巴裡動不了。一位農夫走過來哈哈大笑：「你是這個星期第三台了！」他說，「從上個月開始，導航就一直把人帶到這條路上。」農夫去開曳引機的時候，叔叔只能在路邊等了一個小時，手腳都被蚊子叮。他終於回到家後跟我們說：「我還是會用導航，但我也會用自己的眼睛。」

passages.title: 球星的簽名球
passages.text: My brother has been a baseball fan {1} he was six. His biggest {2} is collecting baseball cards, and he has more than five hundred of them. Last week, a {3} player from Japan came to the Taipei Dome for a game. My brother couldn't sleep the night before. After the game, we {4} outside the gate for two hours. It was cold and windy, but nobody wanted to leave. When the player finally came out, hundreds of fans {5} him to his bus, shouting his name. My brother held out his ball and a pen. The player stopped, smiled, and signed it! My brother looked like he was going to cry. Now the ball sits in a glass box on his desk. Every morning, he says "good morning" to it before he says it to us.

blanks.why: since + 子句，搭配現在完成式 has been「自從他六歲起」。than、whether、below 放在這裡不能表示「從…以來」。
his biggest interest「他最大的興趣」是收集球員卡。season、hospital、ticket 不能用「收集球員卡」來說明。
a famous player「一位有名的球員」。famous 是形容詞，可以修飾名詞；usually、already 是副詞，alone 不能放在名詞前面。
wait outside the gate「在大門外等」。answered、grew、built outside the gate 意思不通。
follow + 人 + to + 地方「跟著某人到某處」：球迷跟著他走到巴士。waited 後面不能直接接人；traveled him、believed him to his bus 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我哥哥從六歲開始就是棒球迷。他最大的興趣是收集球員卡，已經有五百多張了。上個星期，一位來自日本的知名球員到台北大巨蛋比賽。哥哥前一晚興奮得睡不著。比賽結束後，我們在大門外等了兩個小時。天氣又冷風又大，但沒有人想走。那位球員終於出來時，好幾百個球迷跟著他走到巴士，一邊喊他的名字。哥哥把球和筆遞過去。球員停下來，笑了笑，幫他簽了名！哥哥看起來快哭了。現在那顆球放在他書桌上的玻璃盒裡。每天早上，他都先跟那顆球說「早安」，才跟我們說。

passages.title: 爸爸住院的那一週
passages.text: Last month, my dad hurt his back at work and had to stay in the {1} for a week. Dad {2} cooks dinner for our family, so Mom and I had to learn fast. The first night, I burned the rice. The second night, the noodles were too salty, and Mom laughed so hard that she couldn't eat. But we kept trying. By Friday, I could {3} make fried eggs and tomato soup. Every evening after dinner, we took the bus to visit Dad. He looked tired, and he missed home a lot. "I can't {4} to come back," he said every night. When he finally came home, I made him a bowl of my tomato soup. He tasted it and smiled. "This is the best thing I've eaten {5} I got hurt," he said. Now I cook dinner every Sunday, and Dad gets to rest.

blanks.why: stay in the hospital「住院」。season、interest、festival 都不是因為背受傷要待一個星期的地方。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 cooks 前面，表示平常都是爸爸煮飯。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
already「已經」：到了星期五，我已經會煎蛋和煮番茄湯了。than、since、until 不能放在 could 和動詞 make 中間。
can't wait to + 動詞「等不及要…」。travel、follow、interest 不能和 can't … to come back 組成這個意思。
since + 子句，搭配現在完成式 I've eaten「自從我受傷以來」。than、whether、below 不能表示「從…以來」。

passages.zh: 上個月，我爸爸工作時傷到背，必須住院一個星期。家裡平常都是爸爸煮晚餐，所以媽媽和我得趕快學。第一天晚上，我把飯煮焦了。第二天晚上，麵太鹹，媽媽笑到吃不下。但我們一直試。到了星期五，我已經會煎蛋和煮番茄湯了。每天晚餐後，我們都搭公車去看爸爸。他看起來很累，也很想家。「我等不及要回家了，」他每天晚上都這麼說。他終於出院回家時，我為他煮了一碗番茄湯。他喝了一口，笑著說：「這是我受傷以來吃過最好吃的東西。」現在我每個星期天負責煮晚餐，讓爸爸休息。

passages.title: 弟弟的蝸牛朋友
passages.text: The rainy {1} in Taiwan starts in May. Most people don't like it, but my little brother Ben loves it, because snails {2} come out after the rain. Ben has a strange {3}: he is crazy about snails. He knows what they eat, how long they live, and why they hide in their shells. One morning, he {4} a snail across our yard for twenty minutes. It moved so slowly that Mom thought Ben was asleep on the grass. This month, Ben has {5} given names to twelve snails. There's Speedy, there's Captain, and there's one called Mom. My mother wasn't happy about that. Ben's teacher, however, thinks his hobby is great. She asked him to give a short talk about snails in class. Ben was so excited that he practiced in front of his snails every day.

blanks.why: the rainy season「雨季」。hospital、ticket、interest 和 rainy 搭配意思不通，也不會「五月開始」。
usually「通常」放在動詞 come 前面：蝸牛通常在雨後出來。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
a strange interest「奇怪的興趣」，冒號後說明他熱愛蝸牛。season、hospital、market 不能用「熱愛蝸牛」來說明。
follow + 東西「跟著…」：他跟著一隻蝸牛穿過院子。waited 要說 waited for；traveled a snail、believed a snail 意思不通。
has already + 過去分詞「已經…了」：這個月他已經幫十二隻蝸牛取名字。than、until、below 不能放在 has 和 given 中間。

passages.zh: 台灣的雨季從五月開始。大部分的人都不喜歡，但我弟弟 Ben 很愛，因為蝸牛通常在下雨後出來。Ben 有個奇怪的興趣：他超愛蝸牛。他知道蝸牛吃什麼、能活多久，還有為什麼會躲進殼裡。有一天早上，他跟著一隻蝸牛穿過院子，跟了二十分鐘。那隻蝸牛爬得好慢，媽媽還以為 Ben 在草地上睡著了。這個月，Ben 已經幫十二隻蝸牛取了名字，有「快腿」、有「隊長」，還有一隻叫「媽媽」。我媽對這件事不太開心。不過 Ben 的老師覺得他的嗜好很棒，請他在課堂上做一個關於蝸牛的簡短報告。Ben 興奮極了，每天都在他的蝸牛面前練習。

passages.title: 等不及的包裹
passages.text: On Monday, I ordered a new video game online. The website said that it {1} takes three days to arrive. I couldn't {2} to play it. I checked the tracking page every hour, even during class. On Tuesday, my package {3} from a warehouse in Taoyuan to Taichung. On Wednesday afternoon, the page said "Delivered," but there was nothing at my door! I looked under the mat and behind the plants. Nothing. I almost called the store to complain. Then, on Thursday morning, my neighbor knocked on our door with a box in her hands. "This came yesterday while you were at school," she said. "I've kept it for you {4} then." I thanked her about ten times. That night, I played until Mom turned off the Wi-Fi. By then, I had {5} finished the first three levels.

blanks.why: usually「通常」：網站說通常要三天才會送到。than、since、below 不能放在主詞和動詞 takes 中間。
can't wait to + 動詞「等不及要…」。build、order、notice to play it 意思不通。
travel from A to B「從 A 移動到 B」：包裹從桃園的倉庫送到台中。waited、followed、interested from … to … 意思不通。
since then「從那時起」，搭配現在完成式 I've kept。than then、whether then、below then 都不通。
had already + 過去分詞「已經…了」：那時我已經破了前三關。than、whether、below 不能放在 had 和 finished 中間。

passages.zh: 星期一，我在網路上訂了一款新的電玩遊戲。網站說通常要三天才會送到。我等不及想玩了。我每個小時都去看物流追蹤頁面，連上課時也是。星期二，包裹從桃園的倉庫送到了台中。星期三下午，頁面上寫著「已送達」，但我家門口什麼都沒有！我找了腳踏墊下面、盆栽後面，都沒有。我差點打電話去店家抱怨。結果星期四早上，鄰居捧著一個箱子來敲門。「這是昨天你去上學時送來的，」她說，「我從那時候就一直幫你收著。」我跟她道謝了大概十次。那天晚上，我一直玩到媽媽把 Wi-Fi 關掉。那時，我已經破了前三關。

passages.title: 雨中的公車站
passages.text: Satsuki and her little sister Mei were {1} at the bus stop for their father. It was the rainy {2}, and the sky was getting dark. Their father {3} came home on the six o'clock bus, but tonight the bus was late. Mei was tired, and by seven she was {4} asleep on Satsuki's back. Suddenly, Satsuki heard heavy steps next to her. She looked up. A huge gray creature was standing beside her! It was Totoro, and he had only a leaf on his head. The rain was falling on his face. Satsuki was surprised, but she wasn't afraid. She gave him her father's umbrella. Totoro jumped up and down when he heard the rain hit it. To say thank you, he gave her a small {5}: a bag of nuts and seeds. Then a giant cat bus came and took him away.

blanks.why: wait at the bus stop for + 人「在公車站等某人」。traveling、following、interesting at the bus stop 意思不通。
the rainy season「雨季」。hospital、interest、ticket 和 rainy 搭配意思不通。
usually「通常」：爸爸通常搭六點的公車回家，但今晚車子誤點。than、since、below 不能放在主詞和動詞 came 中間。
already「已經」：Mei 很快就已經睡著了。than、whether、below 不能放在 was 和 asleep 中間。
a small gift「一份小禮物」，冒號後說明是一袋堅果和種子。weather、ticket、season 都不能用「一袋堅果」說明。

passages.zh: 小月和妹妹小梅在公車站等爸爸。那時是雨季，天色漸漸暗了。爸爸平常都搭六點的公車回家，但今晚公車誤點了。小梅很累，到了七點已經在小月背上睡著了。突然，小月聽到身旁傳來沉重的腳步聲。她抬頭一看，一隻巨大的灰色生物站在她旁邊！那是龍貓，牠頭上只頂著一片葉子，雨水一直打在牠臉上。小月很驚訝，但並不害怕。她把爸爸的雨傘給了牠。龍貓聽到雨打在傘上的聲音，開心得跳上跳下。為了道謝，牠送給小月一份小禮物：一袋堅果和種子。接著，一台巨大的貓公車來了，把牠載走了。

passages.title: 第一次出國去大阪
passages.text: This summer, my family {1} to Osaka. It was my first time going abroad, and I was so excited that I packed my bag a week early. Osaka is {2} for its street food, so we ate all day long. My favorite was takoyaki, little balls with pieces of octopus inside. The most popular shop had a long line, and we had to {3} for forty minutes. But it was worth it! Dad has a strong {4} in history, so we also visited Osaka Castle. He read every sign there, and it took forever. On the last day, we got lost in a huge train station. Everything was in Japanese, and we couldn't find our train. A kind old man saw us and told us to {5} him. He walked with us all the way to the right train and then waved goodbye.

blanks.why: travel to + 地方「到某地旅行」。waited、followed、interested to Osaka 意思不通。
be famous for「以…聞名」：大阪以街頭美食出名。usually、already 是副詞，alone 不能接 for its street food 表示「以…出名」。
wait for forty minutes「等了四十分鐘」，前面說店門口大排長龍。travel、follow、grow for forty minutes 意思不通。
have an interest in + 事物「對…有興趣」。season、hospital、ticket in history 意思不通。
tell + 人 + to follow him「叫某人跟著他」，後面說他一路帶我們走到月台。wait 要說 wait for him；travel him、grow him 意思不通。

passages.zh: 今年夏天，我們全家去大阪旅行。這是我第一次出國，我興奮到提前一週就把行李收好了。大阪以街頭美食聞名，所以我們從早吃到晚。我最喜歡的是章魚燒，就是裡面包著章魚塊的小丸子。最有名的那家店大排長龍，我們等了四十分鐘，但很值得！爸爸對歷史很有興趣，所以我們也去了大阪城。他把那裡的每一塊告示牌都看完了，花了超久。最後一天，我們在一個超大的車站裡迷路了。所有東西都是日文，我們找不到要搭的火車。一位親切的老先生看到我們，叫我們跟著他走。他一路陪我們走到正確的火車旁，然後揮手道別。

passages.title: 弟弟的作業說謊記
passages.text: My little brother Max hates homework. Every night, Mom asks, "Have you finished your homework?" And every night, Max answers, "Yes! I've {1} finished it." But one night, Mom decided to check his bag. Max's notebook was empty. He had been playing games on his tablet {2} dinner. Mom wasn't angry, but she made a new rule. Now Max {3} does his homework at the kitchen table while Mom cooks. If he has a question, he doesn't have to {4} long for help, because Mom is right there. Max complained a lot at first. He said the kitchen was too noisy and too hot. But after a month, his grades got much better, and his teacher wrote "Great job!" on his math test. Last week, Max even said to me, "You should {5} my example and do your homework early." I just laughed.

blanks.why: have already + 過去分詞「已經…了」：Max 每次都說他已經寫完了。than、whether、below 不能放在 I've 和 finished 中間。
since + 過去時間點，搭配完成進行式 had been playing「從晚餐後就一直在玩」。than、whether、below dinner 意思不通。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 does 前面，表示現在的習慣。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
wait long for help「等很久才得到幫忙」：媽媽就在旁邊，不用等。follow、travel、grow long for help 意思不通。
follow one's example「以某人為榜樣、照著做」。wait my example、travel my example、grow my example 都不通。

passages.zh: 我弟弟 Max 討厭寫作業。每天晚上媽媽都會問：「作業寫完了嗎？」而每天晚上 Max 都回答：「寫完了！我已經寫完了。」但有一天晚上，媽媽決定檢查他的書包，結果 Max 的作業簿是空白的。他從吃完晚餐就一直在用平板玩遊戲。媽媽沒有生氣，但訂了一條新規定。現在 Max 通常在媽媽煮飯時坐在廚房餐桌寫作業。有問題時，他不用等很久，因為媽媽就在旁邊。一開始 Max 一直抱怨，說廚房太吵又太熱。但一個月後，他的成績進步很多，老師還在他的數學考卷上寫了「做得好！」上星期，Max 甚至對我說：「你應該學我，早點寫作業。」我只能笑一笑。

passages.title: 爆紅的柴犬麻糬
passages.text: Our dog Mochi became {1} by accident. Last spring, my sister posted a short video of him on the internet. In the video, Mochi was {2} for his dinner. He sat in front of his empty bowl and didn't move at all, but his face looked so sad that people couldn't stop laughing. One week later, the video had {3} been watched two million times. A TV show even called us and asked to film him. {4} then, many people have sent him letters, toys, and dog snacks from all over the world. Some fans even come to our street to take photos with him. But Mochi doesn't care about any of it. He {5} sleeps on the sofa all day and only wakes up when he hears the sound of his food bag. To him, dinner is still the most important thing in the world.

blanks.why: become famous「出名」：麻糬意外爆紅。already、usually、together 不能放在 became 後面當補語。
wait for + 東西「等待…」：影片裡麻糬在等晚餐。traveling、following、interesting for his dinner 意思不通。
had already been watched「已經被看了」：一週後影片已有兩百萬次觀看。than、whether、below 不能放在 had 和 been 中間。
Since then「從那時起」，搭配現在完成式 have sent。Than then、Whether then、Below then 都不通。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 sleeps 前面，表示習慣。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。

passages.zh: 我們家的狗麻糬是意外出名的。去年春天，我姊姊把牠的一段短片放上網路。影片裡，麻糬在等晚餐。牠坐在空碗前一動也不動，但表情委屈到讓大家笑個不停。一個星期後，這段影片已經被看了兩百萬次。甚至有電視節目打電話來，想來拍牠。從那時起，世界各地很多人寄信、玩具和狗零食給牠，有些粉絲還會來我們這條街跟牠合照。但麻糬一點都不在乎。牠通常整天睡在沙發上，只有聽到飼料袋的聲音才會醒來。對牠來說，晚餐還是世界上最重要的事。

passages.title: 玉井的芒果季
passages.text: Summer is mango {1} in Taiwan, and my grandma's town, Yujing in Tainan, is {2} for its sweet mangoes. Every July, my family {3} down south to visit her. Grandma has a small shop that sells mango shaved ice. People come from all over Taiwan to eat it, and on weekends they {4} have to {5} in line for thirty minutes or more. This summer, Grandma let me help in the shop for the first time. I cut the mangoes, and she made the ice. My hands were sticky and yellow all day. In the afternoon, a tourist from Japan ordered one, and Grandma said, "You make this one." I put on too much mango and too much milk. I was worried, but the tourist took one bite and smiled. "This is the best one I've ever had!" she said. Grandma winked at me.

blanks.why: mango season「芒果季」：夏天是台灣的芒果產季。hospital、interest、ticket 和 mango 搭配意思不通。
be famous for「以…聞名」：玉井以香甜的芒果出名。already、usually 是副詞，alone 不能接 for its mangoes 表示「以…出名」。
travel down south「南下旅行」，主詞 my family 是單數所以用 travels。answers、notices、understands down south 意思不通。
usually「通常」放在 have to 前面：週末客人通常要排三十分鐘以上。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
wait in line「排隊等候」。follow、travel、grow in line 意思不通。

passages.zh: 夏天是台灣的芒果季，我阿嬤住的台南玉井就以香甜的芒果聞名。每年七月，我們全家都會南下去看她。阿嬤開了一家賣芒果冰的小店，全台灣的人都會來吃，週末時客人通常要排隊三十分鐘以上。今年夏天，阿嬤第一次讓我在店裡幫忙。我負責切芒果，她負責做冰。我的手整天都黏黏黃黃的。下午，一位日本觀光客點了一碗，阿嬤說：「這碗你來做。」我放了太多芒果，也淋了太多煉乳，心裡很擔心，但那位觀光客吃了一口就笑了。「這是我吃過最好吃的！」她說。阿嬤對我眨了眨眼。

passages.title: 小智和皮卡丘
passages.text: Ash has wanted to be a Pokémon Master {1} he was a little boy. When he turned ten, he left home to {2} around the world with his first Pokémon, Pikachu. But Pikachu didn't like him at first. It refused to go into its Poké Ball, and it {3} gave Ash an electric shock when he got too close. Ash didn't give up. He shared his food with Pikachu and talked to it every night. Then one day, a group of angry birds attacked them on the road. Ash stood in front of Pikachu to protect it, even though he was hurt. After that day, Pikachu began to {4} Ash everywhere. It always sat on his shoulder. Now, years later, the two of them have {5} visited many different places and made lots of friends. They are not just a trainer and a Pokémon. They are best friends.

blanks.why: since + 子句，搭配現在完成式 has wanted「從小時候起就一直想」。than、whether、below 不能表示「從…以來」。
leave home to travel around the world「離家去環遊世界」。wait、interest、grow around the world 意思不通。
usually「通常」：皮卡丘一開始常常電小智。than、since、below 不能放在主詞和動詞 gave 中間。
follow + 人「跟著某人」：之後皮卡丘到哪裡都跟著小智。wait 要說 wait for；travel Ash、hope Ash 意思不通。
have already + 過去分詞「已經…了」：他們已經去過很多地方。than、whether、below 不能放在 have 和 visited 中間。

passages.zh: 小智從小就一直想成為神奇寶貝大師。十歲那年，他帶著第一隻神奇寶貝皮卡丘離家，去環遊世界。但皮卡丘一開始並不喜歡他，牠不肯進精靈球，小智一靠太近，牠通常就會電他。小智沒有放棄，他和皮卡丘分享食物，每天晚上都跟牠說話。後來有一天，一群憤怒的鳥在路上攻擊他們。小智擋在皮卡丘前面保護牠，就算自己受了傷也不退開。從那天起，皮卡丘不管去哪裡都跟著小智，總是坐在他的肩膀上。好幾年過去了，他們已經去過許多不同的地方，也交了很多朋友。他們不只是訓練家和神奇寶貝，更是最好的朋友。

passages.title: 當醫院志工的奶奶
passages.text: My grandma has worked as a volunteer at the city {1} since she retired five years ago. She {2} goes there on Tuesday and Thursday mornings. Her job is to help people find their way. The hospital is very big, and many old people get lost in it. Grandma shows them where to go, and sometimes she {3} with them until a nurse calls their names. Once, I asked her why she does this. "When your grandpa was sick, a volunteer helped us every day," she said. "I {4} remember her kind smile. Now I want to help others in the same way." Last summer, I went with her for a week. I carried wheelchairs, gave out water, and talked with lonely patients. I didn't know much about hospitals before, but now I have a real {5} in becoming a nurse one day.

blanks.why: at the city hospital「在市立醫院」，後面也提到護士和迷路的病人。season、interest、weather 都不是可以當志工的地方。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 goes 前面，表示習慣：她通常星期二和星期四早上去。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
wait with + 人「陪某人一起等」，直到護士叫號。travels、follows、grows with them until … 意思不通。
still「仍然」：我到現在還記得她親切的笑容。least、below、than 不能放在主詞和動詞 remember 中間。
have an interest in + V-ing「對…有興趣」：我現在很想當護士。season、hospital、ticket in becoming a nurse 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我奶奶五年前退休後，就一直在市立醫院當志工。她通常星期二和星期四早上去。她的工作是幫人找路。醫院很大，很多老人家會在裡面迷路。奶奶會告訴他們該往哪裡走，有時還會陪他們一起等，直到護士叫到他們的名字。有一次我問她為什麼要做這件事。「你爺爺生病的時候，每天都有一位志工幫我們，」她說，「我到現在還記得她親切的笑容。現在我想用同樣的方式幫助別人。」去年暑假，我跟她去了一個星期。我幫忙推輪椅、發水，還陪孤單的病人聊天。以前我對醫院了解不多，但現在我真的很想有一天成為護士。

passages.title: 跟著螞蟻走
passages.text: My science teacher gave us strange homework: watch ants for one hour and write down what you see. At first, I thought it would be boring. I put a small piece of cookie on the ground near some ants and {1}. After a few minutes, one ant found it. But it didn't eat it. Instead, it ran back to its home. Soon, a long line of ants came out. Each ant {2} the one in front of it, like cars on a road. My teacher later told us that ants {3} leave a special smell on the ground, so other ants can find the food. Some ants can {4} more than one hundred meters from home to look for food. That's very far for such a tiny animal! By the end of the hour, the cookie was {5} gone. I was surprised. This "boring" homework was the most fun I've had all week.

blanks.why: waited「等待」，這裡不接受詞：放好餅乾後我就在一旁等。traveled、followed 單獨放這裡意思不通；believed 後面缺少相信的內容。
follow + 東西「跟在…後面」：每隻螞蟻都跟著前面那一隻。waited 要說 waited for；traveled、believed the one in front of it 意思不通。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 leave 前面：螞蟻通常會留下氣味。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
travel + 距離「移動（多遠）」：有些螞蟻能走一百多公尺去找食物。notice、answer、prepare more than one hundred meters 意思不通。
already「已經」：一小時結束時，餅乾已經不見了。than、whether、below 不能放在 was 和 gone 中間。

passages.zh: 自然老師給了我們一份奇怪的作業：觀察螞蟻一個小時，把看到的寫下來。一開始，我覺得一定很無聊。我在一群螞蟻附近放了一小塊餅乾，然後等著。過了幾分鐘，有一隻螞蟻找到了它，但牠沒有吃，而是跑回家。很快地，一長排螞蟻出來了，每隻都跟著前面那一隻走，就像路上的車子一樣。後來老師告訴我們，螞蟻通常會在地上留下特別的氣味，讓其他螞蟻找到食物。有些螞蟻能走一百多公尺去找食物，對這麼小的動物來說真的很遠！一小時結束時，餅乾已經不見了。我很驚訝，這份「無聊」的作業竟然是我這星期最好玩的事。

passages.title: 會考倒數一百天
passages.text: I've been getting ready for the big exam in May {1} September. Some days I feel confident, but other days I feel I know nothing. Last month, my cousin, who took the exam last year, gave me some advice, and I decided to {2} it. First, sleep enough. She said she {3} went to bed before eleven, even the night before the test. "A tired brain can't remember anything," she told me. Second, start early. Don't {4} until the last week to review everything. Third, take a break. Go for a walk, play basketball, or listen to music for twenty minutes every day. It's only February now, but I have {5} finished two practice books. I'm still nervous, but I feel much better. I keep a note on my desk with my cousin's words: "You don't have to be perfect. Just do your best."

blanks.why: since + 過去時間點，搭配現在完成進行式 I've been getting ready「從九月起一直在準備」。than、whether、below September 意思不通。
follow advice「聽從建議」，it 指前面的 advice。wait it、travel it、hope it 都不通。
usually「通常」：表姊以前通常十一點前就睡。than、since、below 不能放在主詞和動詞 went 中間。
wait until + 時間「等到…才」：不要等到最後一週才複習。follow、order、answer until the last week 意思不通。
have already + 過去分詞「已經…了」：我已經寫完兩本練習本。than、whether、below 不能放在 have 和 finished 中間。

passages.zh: 從九月開始，我就一直在準備五月的會考。有些日子我很有信心，但有時又覺得自己什麼都不會。上個月，去年考過的表姊給了我一些建議，我決定照著做。第一，睡飽。她說她通常十一點前就睡了，連考試前一晚也一樣。「累的大腦什麼都記不住，」她說。第二，早點開始，不要等到最後一週才複習全部。第三，要休息。每天花二十分鐘散步、打籃球或聽音樂。現在才二月，我已經寫完兩本練習本了。我還是會緊張，但感覺好多了。我在書桌上貼了一張紙條，寫著表姊說的話：「你不用完美，只要盡力就好。」

passages.title: 換季整理衣櫃
passages.text: When the {1} changes, Mom always asks us to clean out our closets. It was {2} November, and the weather was getting cold, but I was still wearing shorts. So last Sunday, I opened my closet and took everything out. I was shocked. I had so many clothes, but I {3} wear the same three T-shirts! At the bottom, I found a blue jacket that I hadn't worn {4} sixth grade. It was too small for me now, and the sleeves only came to my elbows. My little brother saw it and his eyes lit up. He couldn't {5} to try it on. It fit him perfectly. He wore it to school the next day and told everyone that it was a gift from his cool big brother. In the end, I gave away two bags of clothes, and my closet looked twice as big.

blanks.why: the season changes「換季、季節變換」。hospital、interest、ticket changes 意思不通。
already「已經」：都已經十一月了，我還穿短褲。than、since、below 不能放在 was 和 November 中間表示時間。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 wear 前面：我平常都穿那三件 T 恤。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
since + 時間，搭配過去完成式 hadn't worn「從六年級以後就沒穿過」。than、whether、below sixth grade 意思不通。
can't wait to + 動詞「迫不及待要…」。build、order、notice to try it on 意思不通。

passages.zh: 每次換季，媽媽都會叫我們整理衣櫃。那時已經十一月了，天氣越來越冷，我卻還穿著短褲。所以上星期天，我打開衣櫃，把所有東西都拿出來。我嚇了一跳：我有好多衣服，但平常都只穿那三件 T 恤！在最底下，我找到一件從六年級以後就沒穿過的藍色外套。它對我來說太小了，袖子只到手肘。我弟弟看到後眼睛一亮，迫不及待想穿穿看。結果他穿起來剛剛好。隔天他穿去學校，跟大家說這是他很酷的哥哥送的禮物。最後，我捐出了兩袋衣服，衣櫃看起來大了一倍。

passages.title: 老街的牛肉麵
passages.text: There is a {1} beef noodle shop near my school. It has been open {2} 1985, and it still looks the same as in my dad's old photos. The owner, Mr. Lin, {3} opens at eleven, but people start to line up at ten. Tourists even {4} from Japan and Korea to try his noodles. One rainy afternoon, the shop was almost empty, so I asked Mr. Lin about his secret. He laughed and pointed at a big pot. "I cook the soup for twelve hours," he said. "Many young people want everything fast. But good soup needs time. You have to {5} for it." Then he gave me a free bowl. The soup was rich, and the beef was so soft that it almost melted in my mouth. Now, whenever I feel impatient, I think about Mr. Lin and his twelve-hour soup.

blanks.why: a famous shop「一家有名的店」。famous 是形容詞，可以修飾名詞；usually、already 是副詞，alone 不能放在名詞前面。
since + 年份，搭配現在完成式 has been open「從 1985 年開到現在」。than、whether、below 1985 意思不通。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 opens 前面：林老闆通常十一點開門。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
travel from + 地方「從某地遠道而來」：觀光客甚至從日本、韓國來吃。notice、answer、prepare from Japan 意思不通。
wait for it「等待它」：好湯需要時間，你得等。follow、grow、believe for it 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我學校附近有一家有名的牛肉麵店。它從 1985 年開到現在，看起來還是跟我爸爸舊照片裡一模一樣。林老闆通常十一點開門，但大家十點就開始排隊了。觀光客甚至從日本和韓國遠道而來吃他的麵。有一天下雨的下午，店裡幾乎沒人，我就問林老闆有什麼祕訣。他笑著指了指一個大鍋子。「我的湯要熬十二個小時，」他說，「很多年輕人什麼都想要快。但好湯需要時間，你得耐心等。」接著他請我吃了一碗。湯頭很濃，牛肉軟到幾乎在嘴裡化開。現在每當我沒耐心的時候，就會想起林老闆和他熬十二小時的湯。

passages.title: 火星上的暑假
passages.text: In the year 2090, Mia and her parents {1} to Mars for the summer holiday. The trip {2} takes three months, but their new rocket only needed six weeks. On Mars, everything was different. The sky was pink, and the ground was red. A year there is almost twice as long as a year on Earth, so each {3} lasts about six months. Mia stayed with other families in a big glass dome. She couldn't go outside without a space suit. One day, she joined a tour to Olympus Mons, the biggest mountain in the solar system. It is {4} all over the solar system, and Mia had seen it in many books. Before they left the bus, the guide told everyone to {5} her closely. "If you get lost here," she said, "nobody can hear you call for help." Mia held her dad's hand tightly the whole time.

blanks.why: travel to + 地方「到某地旅行」：Mia 一家去火星過暑假。waited、followed、interested to Mars 意思不通。
usually「通常」：這趟旅程通常要三個月，但新火箭只要六週。than、since、below 不能放在主詞和動詞 takes 中間。
each season「每一季」：火星的一年很長，所以每一季大約六個月。hospital、interest、ticket 都不能用「持續六個月」來說明一年的長短。
be famous all over …「在整個…都很有名」，後面說 Mia 在很多書裡看過它。already、usually、alone 放在這裡意思不通。
tell + 人 + to follow her「叫大家緊跟著她」。wait 要說 wait for her；travel her、hope her 意思不通。

passages.zh: 西元 2090 年，Mia 和爸媽去火星過暑假。這趟旅程通常要三個月，但他們的新火箭只花了六個星期。火星上的一切都不一樣：天空是粉紅色的，地面是紅色的。火星的一年幾乎是地球的兩倍長，所以每一季大約持續六個月。Mia 和其他家庭一起住在一個巨大的玻璃圓頂屋裡，沒穿太空衣就不能出去。有一天，她參加了去奧林帕斯山的旅行團，那是太陽系裡最高的山。它在整個太陽系都很有名，Mia 已經在很多書裡看過它。下車前，導遊叫大家緊緊跟著她。「如果在這裡走丟了，」她說，「沒有人聽得到你求救。」Mia 一路上都緊緊握著爸爸的手。

passages.title: 七股的黑面琵鷺
passages.text: Every winter, black-faced spoonbills {1} thousands of kilometers from Korea and China to Taiwan. They {2} arrive in October and fly away in April. My dad has a special {3} in birds, and these are his favorite. Last weekend, he took me to Qigu in Tainan to see them. We hid behind a wooden wall with a few holes in it and {4} quietly. For a long time, nothing happened. My legs got tired, and I almost wanted to go home. Then, suddenly, a group of white birds landed in the water. They moved their long, flat beaks from side to side to catch fish. Dad whispered, "In the 1990s, there were only about three hundred of them in the world." {5} people started to protect them, their number has grown to more than six thousand. I felt lucky to see them with my own eyes.

blanks.why: travel + 距離「移動（多遠）」：黑面琵鷺飛好幾千公里來台灣。answer、notice、prepare thousands of kilometers 意思不通。
usually「通常」放在一般動詞 arrive 前面：牠們通常十月抵達。than、since、below 不能這樣修飾動詞。
have an interest in + 事物「對…有興趣」：爸爸特別喜歡鳥。season、hospital、ticket in birds 意思不通。
waited quietly「安靜地等」，後面說很久都沒動靜。traveled、interested、believed quietly 放在躲在牆後的情境意思不通。
Since + 子句，搭配現在完成式 has grown「自從人們開始保護牠們以來」。Than、Whether、Below 不能表示「從…以來」。

passages.zh: 每年冬天，黑面琵鷺都會從韓國和中國飛好幾千公里來台灣。牠們通常十月抵達，四月離開。我爸爸對鳥特別有興趣，而黑面琵鷺是他的最愛。上個週末，他帶我去台南七股看牠們。我們躲在一面開了幾個小洞的木牆後面，安靜地等待。好長一段時間什麼事都沒發生，我的腳都痠了，差點想回家。突然，一群白色的鳥降落在水面上，牠們左右擺動又長又扁的嘴巴捕魚。爸爸小聲說：「在 1990 年代，全世界只剩大約三百隻。」自從人們開始保護牠們，數量已經增加到六千多隻。能親眼看到牠們，我覺得很幸運。
